config.title: Cognify AI
config.preferredVendor: Language model vendor to try first for every Cognify task, for example `copilot`, `openai`, `gemini`, `anthropic` or `ollama`. Leave empty to use each task's default order.
config.pinnedModel: Exact language model id to use for every Cognify task. If it is unavailable or excluded by other settings, Cognify uses its normal ranking. Leave empty to let Cognify choose.
config.fallbackWhenPinned: When the model in `#cognify.ai.pinnedModel#` fails, fall back to other models instead of reporting the failure.
config.disabledVendors: Language model vendors Cognify must never send requests to, for example `openai`.
config.trustedVendors: Language model vendors that may receive context from workspaces marked confidential (`#cognify.privacy.confidentialWorkspace#`). Local vendors are always allowed.
config.maxCostTier: Most expensive kind of model Cognify may use. Vendors above this tier are skipped.
config.maxCostTier.free: Only free models, such as local Ollama models.
config.maxCostTier.included: Free models and models included in a subscription, such as GitHub Copilot.
config.maxCostTier.metered: Also models billed per use through your own API key, such as OpenAI, Gemini or Anthropic.
config.privacy.localOnly: Send Cognify requests only to local models (for example Ollama). Turning this on in user, workspace, or folder settings applies everywhere it is on; a more specific setting cannot turn it off.
config.privacy.confidentialWorkspace: Mark this workspace as confidential: Cognify sends its content only to local models and to vendors in `#cognify.ai.trustedVendors#`.
